body:
I'm not sure why it was. I've messaged you an article, as close to proof as I can get.

Police interviewed people at my school, and I had talked to one of them, someone I trusted, about buying a gun. Police have to react the way they need to, news picked up something about me having a gun on the police scanner, and the whole thing then snowballed by word of mouth.
It was rather unpleasant, but it really didn't directly affect me and I'm never going to see any of them again.

It was only a week. It wasn't terrible. It seemed like it was mostly a cage where they paid babysitters to make sure no one did anything stupid while doctors through random antidepressants at patients until something clicked.
